## Checklist

- [ ] PR title is a Conventional Commit (`feat(scope): …`, `fix(scope): …`)
- [ ] Branch rebased on its target and named per the Git Flow rules
- [ ] App builds and KametiKit tests pass locally
- [ ] UI uses design-system components and tokens only (no raw colours, sizes or text styles)
- [ ] New or changed DS component checked in light and dark
- [ ] Money maths changed? Reference-sheet tests updated and passing
- [ ] New user-facing strings use `String(localized:bundle:)` (String Catalog)
- [ ] No secrets, `.env` files or private data committed
